name_de: Cube Kathmandu Hybrid ONE11 HPC SLX 800 Easy Entry
name_en: Cube Kathmandu Hybrid ONE11 HPC SLX 800 Easy Entry
description_de: Das Cube Kathmandu Hybrid ONE11 HPC SLX 800 Easy Entry ist ein E-Trekkingbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 500. Federung: Rock Shox Psylo Gold Isolator RC, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm · Dämpfer Rock Shox Deluxe Select+ 165x45mm, Trunnion Mount. Schaltung: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano XT BR-M8120, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Carbon Front Triangle. Erhältlich in den Größen 46 cm, 50 cm, 54 cm, 58 cm.
description_en: The Cube Kathmandu Hybrid ONE11 HPC SLX 800 Easy Entry is an electric trekking bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 500. Suspension: Rock Shox Psylo Gold Isolator RC, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm · Dämpfer Rock Shox Deluxe Select+ 165x45mm, Trunnion Mount. Drivetrain: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano XT BR-M8120, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Carbon Front Triangle. Available in sizes 46 cm, 50 cm, 54 cm, 58 cm.
